name: layer
description: Stacks its children in one box, later ones on top, with the box as tall as the tallest of them.

attributes.name: data-align
attributes.description: Vertical alignment of every child in the box. baseline behaves as start here.

children.description: The layers, bottom first. Place one child on its own with align-self and justify-self.

a11y.notes: Everything stays in reading order. Text laid over a picture needs a contrast treatment (a scrim or a solid panel); the layer does not add one.
